measurement: Counts read actual listener/observer/command/view collections and owned Cordis instances. Bridge unlisten remains counted until its native Promise confirms removal. Subsets are not added to totals.
changes: Bridge total listeners and worker-owned subset are distinct from Rust HostState channel subscriptions
Worker abort callbacks, command observers, commands and views use actual active collections
Cordis global hook tables and fiber-local update tables provide root/plugin listener counts without estimating from effects
Owned instances remain counted during asynchronous disposal and after disposal failure
Cordis internally logged resource cleanup failures are preserved by the owner so the count cannot claim successful release
